trust_decision.summary: Whether a shared native dictionary (ZstdDictCompress/ZstdDictDecompress) may be freed by close() while a context or stream still references its native CDict/DDict pointer; decided by the AutoCloseBase shared-lock counter, which loadDict releases right after the native refCDict/refDDict call instead of holding it for as long as the reference lives.

landing_point.why: The summary names ZstdCompressCtx.loadDict and dictionary sharing; the dict lock is released in its finally block at lines 433-436 while compression_dict keeps the reference.

fix_sites.entry_point: ZstdDictCompress.close() / ZstdDictDecompress.close() (and every AutoCloseBase subclass close())

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/main/java/com/github/luben/zstd/AutoCloseBase.java:60-73 (shared close/refcount primitive used by dicts, contexts and nothing in the report names it); decompress side src/main/java/com/github/luben/zstd/ZstdDecompressCtx.java:64-123 is a second implementation

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names only ZstdCompressCtx.loadDict; the decompress context, the reset()/loadDict(byte[]) release paths and the streaming classes look like neighbouring features, and AutoCloseBase.close() throwing 'Attempt to close while in use' looks like it already protects the dict.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: One ZstdDictCompress/ZstdDictDecompress is shared by many contexts/streams (the 'dictionary sharing' feature) and must stay usable and still be closeable once all users release it; ctx.close() and dict.close() in either order, reset(), and replacing a dict via loadDict(byte[]) or a second loadDict(dict) must keep working without lock underflow or leaking the dict forever. Over-broad fixes (copying the dict per ctx, making dict.close() a no-op/always-throw, double release) break this or ByteBuffer byReference dicts.

O6_input_shapes: ZstdDictCompress object passed to compress ctx
ZstdDictDecompress object passed to decompress ctx
byte[] dict replacing a held dict object

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ZstdOutputStreamNoFinalizer.setDict(ZstdDictCompress) refs the CDict natively without acquiring or holding the dict's shared lock at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Streams are a separate API from the Ctx classes named in the report; the field comment says it only needs to keep the dict from GC.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file, same package; reached via ZstdOutputStream wrapper (src/main/java/com/github/luben/zstd/ZstdOutputStream.java:12)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ZstdInputStreamNoFinalizer.setDict(ZstdDictDecompress) releases the dict lock right after refDDict while active_dict keeps the reference
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Streaming decompression is a neighbouring feature; it already acquires/releases the lock so it looks correct.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file, same package; native refDDict at src/main/native/jni_zstd.c:292

O8_uncovered_routes.route: BaseZstdBufferDecompressingStreamNoFinalizer.setDict(ZstdDictDecompress) releases the lock after refDDict and keeps no reference at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: ByteBuffer streaming classes look like a legacy/secondary transport not mentioned in the report.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (base class of ZstdBufferDecompressingStream/ZstdDirectBufferDecompressingStream), same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ZstdDirectBufferCompressingStreamNoFinalizer holds the dict lock only around initCStreamWithFastDict, which refs the CDict for the remaining stream lifetime
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Direct-buffer streaming is a separate transport with its own native file; lock is taken so it looks handled.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Context close (doClose) never releases a dict lock it holds after the fix model, so ownership is not ended on ctx close
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: close() of the context frees only its own native pointer; releasing the dict there looks like a leak fix, not a safety fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Public static Zstd.loadFastDictCompress/Decompress(long stream, dict) take a raw stream pointer and ref the dict with no lifetime tracking; a planted helper using them would be a lower-level route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: They are already public helpers used by the streams; a maintainer adding a new stream class would call them directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A native loadCDictFast0-style entry with a different arg shape (e.g. ByteBuffer-backed byReference dict) that refs without Java-side ownership.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Native glue is duplicated per class (jni_zstd.c, jni_fast_zstd.c, jni_directbuffercompress_zstd.c).

O9_family: memory safety: use-after-free via native object lifetime/refcount (CWE-416)
